subject.title: [Bug] MiniMax Token Plan (Max) broken in sub-agents after v5.22 bootstrap change

question: Should OpenClaw preserve the AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md-only sub-agent bootstrap boundary and only fix live-proven MiniMax provider/media bugs, or sponsor an explicit sub-agent skill/bootstrap contract for MiniMax Token Plan bundles?
rationale: The source evidence shows both a plausible provider-routing bug candidate and an intentional bootstrap boundary; choosing between narrow repair and broader skill inheritance is a product/compatibility decision.

options.title: Keep Boundary, Verify Provider
options.body: Require live Token Plan proof first, then fix only the confirmed MiniMax endpoint/auth or media-delivery bug while leaving the current sub-agent bootstrap boundary intact.

options.title: Sponsor Opt-In Skill Contract
options.body: Approve a deliberate sub-agent skill or bootstrap-loading contract with docs and upgrade tests before changing which non-AGENTS/TOOLS files children inherit.

options.title: Route Office Skills Out Of Core
options.body: Treat the PPT/Word/Excel/PDF Token Plan pieces as ClawHub/plugin or external mmx CLI packaging unless a missing OpenClaw extension API is proven.

recommendation.title: Keep Boundary, Verify Provider
recommendation.body: Require live Token Plan proof first, then fix only the confirmed MiniMax endpoint/auth or media-delivery bug while leaving the current sub-agent bootstrap boundary intact.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent agent/provider history plus co-authorship on the MiniMax endpoint change make this the best available routing candidate for the mixed provider and product-boundary decision.
